sentences.en: I'm sure there's a more mundane explanation that doesn't involve ghosts.
sentences.zh: 我相信有更好的世俗解释，不需要涉及鬼魂。

sentences.en: The real reason is far more mundane than all of these speculations.
sentences.zh: 真正的原因远比这些猜测更加世俗。

sentences.en: Oh, but that is a mundane matter!
sentences.zh: 哦，但这是一件再普通不过的事情！

senses.zh: 尘世的，世俗化的：relating to world；平凡的：commonplaces
